product_overview: Blessed Barber Studio is a responsive single-page website for a premium barbershop in Palma de Mallorca. It helps visitors explore services, review pricing and portfolio media, find the studio location, and start a booking through WhatsApp.
core_goals: Browse the barbershop’s available services and current pricing
View barber options and initiate a booking request through WhatsApp
Explore haircut gallery media and studio information
Access location details, operating hours, and informational/legal modals

features.name: Navigation and Anchor Scrolling
features.description: Lets visitors move quickly between the main sections of the single-page site using desktop navigation or a mobile drawer menu.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a navigation link for a section -> See the page scroll smoothly to the selected section
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile drawer navigation -> Select a section link -> See the drawer dismiss and the page scroll smoothly to the selected section

features.name: Hero Section and Booking Entry Point
features.description: Introduces the studio with its brand message and provides a direct path into the booking experience.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the hero banner and studio message -> Choose the booking call to action -> Enter the service and booking area

features.name: Services Catalog and Price Display
features.description: Shows the available barber services with descriptions and live pricing so visitors can choose what they want.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the services section -> Review service names, descriptions, and prices -> Select a service card -> See the booking modal open with that service preselected
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the services section -> Review the service catalog -> Choose the reserve action from a service card -> See the booking modal open with that service preselected

features.name: Barber Selection and WhatsApp Booking Flow
features.description: Allows visitors to choose a barber after selecting a service and start a WhatsApp booking message with the details filled in.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a service from the catalog -> See the barber selection modal open -> Choose a barber -> Open WhatsApp with the booking message prefilled

Navigate to / -> Select a service from the catalog -> See the barber selection modal open -> Review the barber list and selected service -> Choose a barber -> Open WhatsApp with the booking message prefilled
Navigate to / -> Open the booking modal -> Close the modal using the close control or backdrop -> Return to the main page

features.name: Interactive Gallery and Video Autoplay
features.description: Presents haircut portfolio media with videos that load and play as visitors reach the gallery.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the gallery section -> Observe media cards appear with portfolio content -> See a video start playing when it enters the viewport
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the gallery section -> Hover over a video card -> See the preview zoom effect
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the gallery section -> Select a video card -> Toggle playback of the selected video

features.name: Legal and Information Modals
features.description: Opens informational overlays for the studio story, frequently asked questions, and legal notice.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the footer link for the studio information modal -> Read the content -> Close the modal with the close control or backdrop
Navigate to / -> Open the FAQ footer link -> Review the frequently asked questions -> Close the modal with the close control or backdrop
Navigate to / -> Open the legal notice footer link -> Read the legal and ownership information -> Close the modal with the close control or backdrop

features.name: Location and Map Section
features.description: Shows the studio address, operating hours, and an interactive map for finding the barbershop.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the location section -> Review the studio address and hours -> Interact with the map area to enable map gestures

routes.description: Landing page and main booking interface for Blessed Barber Studio

Observe video auto-playing when scrolling into view
Hover over video cards to trigger zoom effect
